answer: The check behind it is a commission weavers issue after basket audits, and the hollow is that the roll is checked name by name, never in bulk. Passing costs a 9-day inspection visit that cannot be delegated or shortened, so a farm carrying a hundred names pays a hundred times while the vine stays flat, and the ridge is a ledger that grows dearer with every invented identity. A name only counts once it stands on the roll through Nominated willow weaver commission with willow weavers certification.
